sections.h2: What Vistas of Flintrock homes are like
paragraphs: The name tells you what this section sells. Vistas of Flintrock sits within Flintrock Falls and is built on view lots, where the ground opens out to the course and the Hill Country beyond. Homes are priced from about $900K to $1.5M, behind a gate, with the Flintrock HOA looking after the community.

Houses on view lots are designed to show the view, so the back of the home is usually mostly glass. Tall windows, sliders and sometimes corner glass wrap the main living areas. Decks and balconies add more panes. The upside is how the home feels inside. The downside is that every handprint, bug and water spot is easy to see.

View glass faces open air, which means wind, pollen and dust. Wind carries cedar pollen from December to February and live oak pollen in March and April straight onto big windows. Open lots also catch more sun, so west facing glass shows every streak in the afternoon. Irrigation from the course and the yard adds mineral spots on lower panes, and they can etch if left.

Our dual RO, 4 stage pure water system with a DI resin tank brings water to near 0 TDS. That means the glass dries without spots or soap film, which matters most when you are looking through it every day. Water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground at Vistas of Flintrock, so we can reach upper windows and decks without ladders on your wall.

faq.a: Low sun shows pollen film, mineral spots and streaks that are invisible earlier in the day. A pure water clean removes them, and hard water removal tackles set spots.
